title: Discrete Gromov-Wasserstein Duality: Algorithms and Isomorphism Testing
abstract: arXiv:2609.03094v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) distance provides a principled framework for aligning metric measure (mm) spaces based solely on their intrinsic structure. Its ability to identify isomorphic representations of distributions across spaces renders it valuable for comparing data where equality up to isomorphism occurs naturally such as in graphs or, more generally, distributions on graphs. Recently, a type of dual form for the GW distance between Euclidean distributions with the squared Euclidean or inner product costs was derived, spurring the development of new statistical and algorithmic results for this setting. This work furnishes a novel duality result for GW distances with and without entropic regularization that is applicable to all finitely supported mm spaces. Leveraging this result, we derive the sample complexity of empirical GW distances between finite mm spaces, as well as limit distributions under proper centering and scaling.

translated_title: 离散 Gromov-Wasserstein 对偶性：算法与同构测试
translated_abstract: Gromov-Wasserstein（GW）距离提供了一个仅基于内在结构来对齐度量测度（mm）空间的原理性框架。它能够识别分布在空间之间的同构表示，这使其在比较那些自然存在同构意义下相等关系的数据时非常有价值，例如图，或更一般地，图上的分布。最近，针对具有平方欧氏距离或内积代价的欧氏分布之间的 GW 距离，研究者推导出了一种对偶形式，推动了该设置下新的统计与算法结果的发展。本工作为带熵正则化与不带熵正则化的 GW 距离提供了一个新的对偶性结果，且适用于所有有限支撑的度量测度空间。利用这一结果，我们推导了有限度量测度空间之间经验 GW 距离的样本复杂度，以及在适当中心化与缩放下的极限分布。
tldr: 本文提出了适用于所有有限支撑度量测度空间的 GW 距离（含及不含熵正则化）的新型对偶性结果，并据此推导了经验 GW 距离的样本复杂度与极限分布。
en_tdlr: This work establishes a novel duality result for GW distances, with and without entropic regularization, applicable to all finitely supported metric measure spaces, from which the sample complexity and limit distributions of empirical GW distances are derived.
